body:
### Question

I'm working on adding etag support for the simple API responses in [devpi-server](https://github.com/devpi/devpi). I always get warnings like ``WARN Server returned unusable 304 for: http://127.0.0.1:3141/root/pypi/+simple/pyramid/`` and ``uv`` is sending another ``GET`` without the etag. Do I have to set any other headers in the response to make this work? What does ``uv`` require for this?

### Platform

Darwin 24.6.0 arm64

### Version

uv 0.12.3 (507230998 2026-08-07 aarch64-apple-darwin)
title: How to make simple API responses cachable with etags
